name: Running Brook Camps Day Camp
description_short: Co-ed day camp at Chapel Hill-Chauncy Hall School in Waltham for children from age 3.5 through completed 6th grade, run in four two-week sessions from June 28 to August 20, 2027. Activities include arts and crafts, drama, gym games, and nature, with archery, a challenge course, and STEM for older campers. Snack and lunch are provided.

refund_policy_summary: A $50 registration fee per child and a $300 deposit per two-week session are due at registration; full payment and forms are due March 31, 2027. Until March 17, 2027 (Commitment Day) one session can be dropped for an account credit; dropping more is allowed only if there is a waitlist, otherwise the full balance is owed.
